body:
[72-project-sources-details] At task entry or new area, discover governing instructions, project sources and applicable skills before substantive work.
Full standing text is delivered periodically via remind.suffix (send_on_start:false); the constant copy already lives in project AGENTS.md startup context.

remind.suffix:
[Project sources — details reminder]

At task entry or before substantive work in new area, discover governing instructions, project sources and applicable skills. Read needed content, conditions, exceptions and decisive truncated material. Scope/obligations established → proceed. Reopen only what new work, changed instructions or contrary evidence makes relevant.

_comment: Cadence mirrors zcode hook: this reminder fires every N events (N=17). Text is byte-faithful to its source export.
